text: Using the Grassberger-Procaccia algorithm, the lab expects the correlation dimension D_2 of the Lorenz attractor to be approximately ___ (and a faithful ESN prediction should reproduce it to within about 0.1).
explanation: The Lorenz attractor's correlation dimension is ~2.05 (Grassberger & Procaccia 1983); the lab prints 'expected ~ 2.05 for Lorenz' and treats agreement within ~0.1 as success. This fractional (non-integer) value is the fingerprint of a strange attractor whose sheet-like structure lives in 3-D space.
